actions.readOnly: An owner or an admin makes these changes.
actions.denied: Changing a role and removing a member are Owner and Admin actions.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It is the second segment of every URL in this workspace.
fields.roleNameHint: Lowercase letters and digits, separated by a dot, a hyphen, or an underscore. It cannot change later.

deleteRole.title: Delete {name}
deleteRole.body: The role and its grants go. The audit record keeps what it allowed.

archiveWorkspace.title: Archive {name}
archiveWorkspace.body: The workspace leaves the switcher. Its slug stays taken, and its runs and frames stay readable.

role.title: Change the role of {name}
role.body: This replaces the role they hold across the organization. The record keeps the change with your name on it.
role.label: Role

remove.title: Remove {name} from the organization
remove.body: They lose {role} and every workspace grant, and Oxagen revokes the command-line keys they minted. Runs stay attributed to them. Only a new invitation brings them back.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Denied. An owner or an admin makes this change.
failure.noPrincipal: The request carried no signed-in user. Sign in and try again.
failure.delegationCeiling: Denied. A role cannot grant more than you hold. Drop the permissions you do not hold, or ask an owner.
failure.roleExists: That name is taken in this organization. Pick another.
failure.roleNotFound: This organization has no role by that name. Nothing was changed.
failure.roleInUse: Principals still hold this role. Reassign them, then delete it.
failure.systemRoleReadonly: Built-in roles are read-only. Duplicate this one to change its permissions.
failure.slugTaken: That slug is taken in this organization. Pick another.
failure.workspaceNotFound: That workspace has left this organization. Reload the page.
failure.workspaceHasAgents: Agents are still registered in this workspace. Deregister or move them, then archive it.
failure.invalid: The request was refused as invalid. Nothing was changed.
failure.pendingApproval: The change is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The change could not be made: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.refused: The change was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.lastOwner: This is the last owner of the organization. Make someone else an owner first.
failure.targetNotMember: This person is no longer a member of this organization.
failure.roleNotGrantable: That role is not one this organization grants. Nothing was changed.
failure.insufficientRole: Your organization role does not allow this change. Nothing was changed.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.empty: No invitations are waiting for an answer.

denied.title: You cannot see this organization’s people
denied.body: Signed in as {role}. Needed: {permission}. An owner can grant it, and the grant is recorded in the audit record.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Access request {id} is waiting for an owner’s decision.

error.title: Organization could not be loaded
error.body: {status} {code}. Nothing was changed. Reload the page to try again.

roleCatalog.title: Roles
roleCatalog.lead: What each role allows, and who holds it.

enforcement.enforced: Oxagen checks these grants on governed calls.
enforcement.recorded: recorded, not enforced. Oxagen records these grants for the {tier} tier and allows every governed action whatever a role says.

catalog.title: Permission catalogue
catalog.lead: A permission is a named bundle of capabilities. A role allows a permission when it allows every capability in it.
